definitions.gloss: tea drinking; consumption of tea or coffee
definitions.explanation: The act of drinking tea or coffee, especially in a leisurely or social context. In contemporary Japanese it appears mostly as part of compound words denoting cafes.

examples.japanese: {駅前|えきまえ}に{喫茶|きっさ}コーナーがある。
examples.english: There's a tea-and-coffee corner in front of the station.

examples.japanese: {学園祭|がくえんさい}でクラスがメイド{喫茶|きっさ}を{出|だ}した。
examples.english: At the school festival, our class ran a maid cafe.

examples.japanese: {昭和|しょうわ}の{雰囲気|ふんいき}が{残|のこ}る{純|じゅん}{喫茶|きっさ}でゆっくり{過|す}ごした。
examples.english: I spent some quiet time at an old-fashioned cafe with a Showa-era atmosphere.

notes:
Literally "drinking tea". Rarely used as a standalone word in modern speech; it appears mainly in compounds for cafes and tea shops.

COMPOUNDS:
- {喫茶店|きっさてん}: cafe; coffee shop
- {純|じゅん}{喫茶|きっさ}: traditional retro cafe (no alcohol)
- メイド{喫茶|きっさ}: maid cafe
- コスプレ{喫茶|きっさ}: cosplay cafe
- {猫|ねこ}{喫茶|きっさ}: cat cafe

SIMILAR WORDS:
- カフェ: cafe — modern loanword, more stylish or Western-leaning
- {茶店|ちゃみせ}: traditional tea house — old-fashioned, often near temples or scenic spots
